title: fastroute rule confirmation (format_version 1.x)
description: A person's explicit decision about one draft: which rules are executed, which relaxations are accepted, and that the rules that will not be executed are known. It names the draft by its SHA-256, so it is void if the draft changes.

draft_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the draft file as confirmed

name.description: the person who decided; must not be empty

accepted_rules.description: ids of the hard / soft rules to execute

accepted_relaxations.description: ids of accepted rules that loosen a limit of the design

acknowledged_not_executed.description: ids of every rule that will NOT be executed (unknown, unsupported, not applicable here), acknowledged one by one
